# FDG9009

> DO use events instead of delegate-based APIs in aggregate components.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: delegate parameters are right in factored types and other APIs (section 6.1.3, FDG6004 to FDG6010), so a check would have to know which types are aggregate components.

## From the book

Aggregate components are optimized for ease of use, and events are much easier to use than APIs using delegates. See section 5.4 for more details.
